name: Countdown
description: Numbered countdown with a big animated number per item. Scene 1 is the hook, middle scenes are the items, the last scene is the payoff and CTA.
prompt_hint: Scene 1: 'N things that X' hook teasing the best item. Middle scenes: one item each, onScreenText = the item title (2-5 words), best item last. Final scene: payoff + one CTA like 'save this'. 3-6 seconds per item. Use an emoji visual per item.
